title: FINETUNING TEXT-TO-IMAGE DIFFUSION MODELS FOR FAIRNESS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the disparity in representation between perceived male and female identities in generated images using a pre-trained gender classifier on detected faces.
Measuring the disparity in representation among four consolidated racial categories (WMELH, Asian, Black, Indian) in generated images using a pre-trained face attribute classifier.
Evaluating the representation disparity across 8 intersectional groups (binary gender combined with four racial categories) in generated images using pre-trained classifiers.
Assessing the representation of age groups (young vs. old) in generated images across occupations using an independently trained age classifier on detected faces.
